title: Minneapolis, MN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Minneapolis is a city in MN with a population of 429,954. City of Lakes with parks, bike trails, and a thriving arts scene despite brutal winters. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
